tools.name: get_menu
tools.description: The full menu grouped by category, with offers first. Each item has a VAT-inclusive starting price, a slug for get_menu_item / get_offer, and its page url.

branch_slug.description: Branch slug from list_branches. Defaults to "all", the country-wide catalogue.

tools.name: get_menu_item
tools.description: Full detail for one menu item: sizes, required and optional choices with their price effect, and defaults.

branch_slug.description: Branch slug from list_branches. Defaults to "all", the country-wide catalogue.

tools.name: get_offer
tools.description: Full detail for one offer (bundle): fixed price plus the slots to fill — mains, fries, drinks, free items — and any upgrade costs.

branch_slug.description: Branch slug from list_branches. Defaults to "all", the country-wide catalogue.

tools.name: list_branches
tools.description: All live restaurant branches with address, coordinates and which order types they accept.

tools.name: open_page
tools.description: Navigate this browser tab to a menu item or offer so the customer can customise and order it. Use the slug and kind returned by get_menu.

slug.description: Item or offer slug from get_menu.
